info.name: ClaimFlow
info.description:
All ClaimFlow APIs through the gateway (http://localhost:8000).

Folders 1-4 are for exploring and chain variables (run them in order). Folder 5 is a self-contained end-to-end journey with assertions; folder 6 shows every error status. Both 5 and 6 run in the Collection Runner or with Newman.

Every request gets an X-Correlation-ID (collection pre-request script), so you can grep for it in the service logs. Generated by postman/generate_collection.py; edit that, not this file.

exec: // Trace every request: add a correlation id unless the request sets its own
// Routed API calls only: the gateway's own /actuator endpoints don't pass its routing filters

item.description: Gateway health. Works in both run modes.

item.description: Only when services run with java -jar (README option B). In Docker only the gateway is published.

item.name: 3. Claim Service
